scope: Post-hoc revised evaluation of unchanged v1 submissions; exploratory regrade, not an unseen preregistered model run.

voice.identity: OpenVoice V2 tone-color encoder. Public 01/09/13 source and target prototypes. 8s chunks, 4s hops. Margin=cos(target)-cos(source). Zero=P95 authentic heldout source margins; full=P05 authentic heldout target margins; clip linear 0..1. Query identity=median chunk progress; worst chunk=P20.
voice.identity_validation: Require heldout target P05 minus source P95 >0.03 in each mode. This is a dataset-specific tone-color proxy, not human-validated speaker verification.
voice.no_change: After polarity/global gain and at most 20ms delay compensation: abs waveform correlation>=0.995 AND >=80% active 0.5s blocks have residual <=-30dB. Such a query scores 0. Silence/missing audio also scores 0. Active threshold=guide peak block RMS -40dB.
voice.spectral_progress: For spectral/vowel/consonant errors from frozen v1 measures, weights .6/.25/.15; progress=clip((unchanged_source_error-candidate_error)/(unchanged_source_error-v1_full_threshold),0,1). Omit non-discriminating metrics with baseline-full<=0.1; renormalize remaining weights.
voice.performance: 3*clip((2-pitch_error)/(2-.25),0,1) + 1*clip((.5-vibrato_error)/(.5-.05),0,1) + 1*clip((guide_envelope_correlation-.5)/.45,0,1). Pitch/voicing and vibrato definitions retained from v1.
voice.judge: Qwen native audio receives separate reference/guide/candidate files, blinded to condition, model and previous score. Naturalness/artifact/content integer 0..4 anchors in prompt; points=weight*rating/4. Qwen identity judgments are diagnostic ONLY because identity calibration failed.
voice.repeats: Two file orders; if any scored rating differs by >1, request a third order. Average two when consistent, otherwise median of three. Retain all raw judgments. Full query audio, no candidate-based excerpt selection.
voice.aggregation: Apply caps and no-change penalty per query; average queries within each mode, then modes equally. Also apply the same caps to each mode mean of identity/naturalness/content, so one failed mode cannot be hidden by the other.
voice.acceptance: Sound>=80 and existing engineering pass; engineering contributes 0 points.

synth.objective: Retain the 12 declared behavioral probe groups, using baseline-relative gain instead of old preset zero thresholds. For each asset/rubric: progress=clip((native_init_error-candidate_error)/(native_init_error-v1_full_threshold),0,1). Rubrics with baseline-full<0.5dB are non-discriminating and omitted; remaining original weights renormalize to 70. Native Init uses original hidden MIDI, default instrument, no adaptation.
synth.judge: All 24 full query pairs against independent native target renders, two file orders; third presentation on scored rating disagreement >1. Native Qwen assesses timbre, temporal behavior, unwanted artifacts; mono judge never scores stereo.
synth.judge_mapping: Match ratings 0/1 ->0, 2->.25, 3->.65, 4->1 (linear interpolation between anchors); artifact_freedom=rating/4.
synth.aggregation: Per-asset objective+judge, apply per-asset caps; A/B/C equal. Engineering contributes 0.
synth.acceptance: Sound>=80, each asset>=65, existing engineering pass. Missing executable instruments or input-audio replay engines are invalid submissions, not playable reconstructions.

integrity: Freeze protocol, v2 scripts, calibration and pre-existing rendered-query hashes BEFORE grading existing Sol outputs with v2. Retain original v1 files and scores. All media work and API requests inside remote Docker. Local receives reports/unchanged deliverables only.
judge_limitations: One model family, two orders, limited controlled validation; not expert listening/MOS. Algorithmic identity is dataset-specific; constructed WORLD spectrum contributes only 10 voice points. Results remain subject to user review.
